versions.subject: Merge PR #4586 from @X-Junior - suspicious WUSA and IME registry keys
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetObject|contains|all:
        - '\Control\Keyboard Layouts\'
        - 'Ime File'
filter_main_known_extension:
    Details|endswith: '.ime'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: TargetObject="*\\Control\\Keyboard Layouts\\*" TargetObject="*Ime File*" NOT Details="*.ime"
